prompt: Generate a vertical 9:16 photograph inside a cramped British corner shop at closing time. A single loaf of plain white sliced bread in a waxed paper wrapper sits alone on a scuffed formica counter, a handwritten orange star sticker on it reading "50p" in black marker. One fluorescent tube overhead buzzes greenish; everything beyond its reach drops into thick black. Behind the counter, a bead curtain into the stockroom hangs very slightly stirred, the darkness through it deep and patient. Shot low at counter height on a 35mm lens at f/2, Kodak 500T tungsten film pushed one stop, heavy grain, soft halation round the tube, faded lino floor, dusty crisp boxes. Ordinary, quiet, and somehow wrong. Thanks.
